title: Hello, welcome to my website!
text:
I am a PhD student in Social Research Methods in the Department of Methodology at the London School of Economics and Political Science, supervised by Prof. Thomas Robinson and Prof. Sara Hobolt. My PhD is funded by an LSE PhD Studentship.
I work in computational social science, using natural language processing, quantitative text analysis, and machine learning to study political and social questions. Alongside my PhD, I am a Postgraduate Research Assistant on the ESRC project Political Memory in the Department of Political Science at University College London.
I hold an M.A. in Sociology and Social Research and a B.A. in Sociology from the University of Bremen. My Master’s thesis combined qualitative content analysis and active machine learning to study incel ideology online.
Feel free to contact me at maratheresaweber@googlemail.com. You can also view my full CV here.
